label: sdc01_0070_caretaker_01
text: Come on, everyone. Pack right in![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0070_caretaker_02
text:
Oh, no need to worry about your shoes or
anything. You can leave them on in here.\c
If they’re extra dirty, just try to rinse off the worst
of the mud using the washing station by the door.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0070_caretaker_03
text: Nice and clean inside, don’t you think? It’s all\nnewly built, so it’s as good as anything you’d\r\nfind in one of your big, fancy cities![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0070_caretaker_04
text: This here is the lounge. You can watch TV, chat,\nor relax however you like.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0070_caretaker_05
text: And, well, let’s see... Over there is the cafeteria.\nAnd toilets will be down that way...[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0070_caretaker_06
text: When you want to get some sleep, please use\nthe rooms down the hall there.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0070_caretaker_07
text: We’ve got enough space that each of you can\nhave a private room to yourself.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0070_caretaker_08
text: So I think...that about covers everything![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0070_caretaker_09
text: But if you run into any trouble at all, don’t you\nhesitate to talk to our fine staff at the desk![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0070_bbteacher_01
text: Thank you for the tour, sir.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0070_bbteacher_02
text: All right, kids, do you have anything to say to\nthe staff who’ll be taking such good care of us?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0070_select_01
text: We’re glad to be here!

label: sdc01_0070_select_02
text: Thanks for having us!

label: sdc01_0070_all_01
text: GLAD TO BE HEEERE!!!

label: sdc01_0070_all_02
text: THANK YOU FOR HAVING UUUS!!!

label: sdc01_0070_caretaker_10
text: What a bunch of well-mannered students! I can\nalready tell you’re going to be wonderful visitors.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0070_caretaker_11
text: So you just think of this place as your own home\naway from home, and relax![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0070_bbteacher_03
text: You must all be tired after such a long day.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0070_bbteacher_04
text: I know it’s a bit early still, but why don’t we\nhave dinner, then call it a night?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0070_caretaker_12
text: We’ve got plenty of food ready for you all,\nso I hope you’ve brought your appetites![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0070_students_01
text: All right!

label: sdc01_0070_students_02
text: Thanks for dinner!

label: sdc01_0070_bbteacher_05
text:
You’re free to spend the rest of the evening as
you like in the community center.\c
But remember that tomorrow, the program will
be officially kicking off.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0070_bbteacher_06
text: Don’t stay up too late, or you might oversleep![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0070_caretaker_13
text: Did you enjoy the taste of our local Kitakami\nfare?[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0070_bbteacher_07
text: The Blueberry students will join us tomorrow.\nI hope you all get along![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0070_student1_01
text: I wonder what’s scheduled for tomorrow... I’m so\nexcited, I don’t think I can sleep!

label: sdc01_0070_student2_01
text: The food here seems really healthy, but it was\nstill really tasty, too!

label: sdc01_0070_student3_01
text: Eep... I checked out my room, and there was a\nbug Pokémon in there!

label: sdc01_0070_stopper_01
text: [EMPTY 30]
